title: webhook-it project config
description: Declares the webhook endpoints of a project. Save it as .webhook-it.json at the repo root and run `wi apply` to reconcile the endpoints into webhook-it.

$schema.description: Optional reference to this schema, for editor autocomplete.

project.description: Namespace for this project. Every endpoint is stored, and exposed in its public URL, as `<project>-<endpoint>` — so two repositories never collide.

endpoints.description: Map of endpoint name to its local forward target.

target.description: Local URL that receives the forwarded webhook, e.g. http://localhost:3000/webhooks/stripe.
